description:
File:crate-jmap-server/src/handlers.rs (consumed from crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:73, ban.rs:72, message.rs:67, space.rs:67, crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs:520, mailbox.rs:61, submission.rs:75, thread.rs:58)
Decision: Each per-type handle_*_changes function was replaced with a single-line delegation to jmap_server::handlers::handle_changes::<T, B>(backend, args).await, eliminating 8 near-identical copies of the sinceState parsing, maxChanges validation, get_changes dispatch, and JSON response assembly.
Why good: The changes response shape is defined entirely by RFC 8620 §5.2, not by the object type — there is nothing type-specific in the logic that was duplicated. Any bug fix or spec-compliance improvement to the response format (e.g. updatedProperties semantics) now needs to be made in exactly one place. The generic approach is enforced at the type system level: the compiler verifies that T implements the required trait bounds, so a handler cannot accidentally call the wrong backend method.
title: GOOD: */changes handlers delegate to generic handle_changes
